bio.text: Bill Redpath is the Libertarian Party's nominee for U.S. Senate in Ohio in 2026, according to his campaign website.

According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Findlay, earned a bachelor's degree in economics and political science from Indiana University and an MBA from the University of Chicago, and had a 38-year career in business valuation.

The site says he has been a member of the Libertarian National Committee for a total of 24 years, including as its chair from 2006 to 2010, and that he is a nine-time Libertarian candidate for public office.
